name: open
description: PR open. The labeller has derived app:* and itil:*; nothing is claimed, nothing is deployed, the build serves nowhere. INITIAL.

name: requested
description: change:requested is present. A person has asked for a change; that is the whole of their part. No reservation and no berth.

name: release_asked
description: the bare `release` label is present and the scheduler has not consumed it yet: a person asking for the whole path now rather than for a slot.

name: scheduled
description: a window is reserved and change:scheduled is set. Berth position 1: a record, nothing blocks on it, and the build is still serving nowhere.

name: activating
description: the window has come due and the guards are being re-derived. Deliberately BEFORE the berth is claimed, so a refusal here leaves nothing held.

name: queued
description: blocked:queue. Another open PR holds deploy:staging; this change carries no claim and is waiting for the singleton.

name: lock_blocked
description: blocked:lock. The deployment lock names another PR and is younger than the 60-minute staleness bound.

name: freeze_blocked
description: blocked:freeze. Preflight refused: the estate is closed to ordinary change, or an emergency is in flight.

name: abstained
description: a guard returned INDETERMINATE and blocked on it: calendar unreachable, production unreachable, deploy set underivable, or a soak that took no probes. Not a refusal and never a pass.

name: berthed
description: deploy:staging plus staging:in-progress. Berth position 2: this change holds the path to production and the staging deploy is in flight.

name: staged
description: staging is observed serving this head SHA. The deploy took; the authorizing run has not been taken yet.

name: verified
description: the authorizing run passed against the staging slot on this head: staging:e2e and staging:smoke, each backed by a record naming the SHA. Berth position 3.

name: soaking
description: the build is held on staging and probed throughout the hold, for build identity as well as HTTP 200.

name: accepted
description: staging:uat. A person used the deployed build and accepted it, and the record names the SHA they looked at. The one human-taken observation.

name: cleared
description: deploy:production is on. Berth position 4: authorized to enter production, nothing placed there yet.

name: idle_deployed
description: the build is installed on the idle colour. It exists in the production tier and carries no traffic.

name: idle_verified
description: the idle colour passed e2e with no traffic on it. The last point at which refusing is free.

name: live
description: the front was cut over. Production serves this build; convergence has not been established.

name: converged
description: guard 5 saw one build across N samples through the front. production:healthy. Sampled, not attested.

name: unconverged
description: production is reachable and is serving more than one build, or is not serving this one. A real negative, distinct from unreachable.

name: validated
description: change:complete is set: every guard passed and production was observed serving this build. Validation is done and the merge has not landed.

name: complete
description: merged, PIR posted, deployment records written from the observation, window redlined passed, berth released. TERMINAL.

name: deployed_not_merged
description: production serves a build trunk does not contain. The window may still be open. The next change branches from a main without it and reverts it on promotion.

name: stranded
description: deployed, not merged, AND the window is gone. Three facts at once and no label says any of them together. The state spec.org names as having no name.

name: orphaned_berth
description: deploy:staging is held with no open window, and the build is serving nowhere or is serving where nobody is driving it. Guard 1 blocks everyone with no declared cause.

name: expired
description: the reservation lapsed unattempted and was closed `expired`. Not failed, not cancelled: nothing was attempted, so nothing failed.

name: authorized_unbooked
description: every observation taken, approval intact, and NO lifecycle label at all. The honest post-reap state: eligible, unbooked, owed nothing, and waiting on a person to ask.

name: preempted
description: an artifact or hotfix merge landed underneath this change. The berth is KEPT and extended, the staging pass is withdrawn, revalidate is required. Being invalidated is not going stale.

name: stale_self
description: self-inflicted staleness: the head moved, or the lease simply ran out. Observations withdrawn, berth released, rejoin the queue.

name: staging_refused
description: the staging deploy or the authorizing run failed on this build; staging:e2e-failed or staging:smoke-failed is recorded. The berth is NOT released by this alone.

name: forfeit_on_entry
description: booked, green, approved, and the acceptance suite refused on entry to staging because the flow changed and the acceptance did not. The window is spent discovering it.

name: emergency_direct
description: itil:emergency: entering production without a staging pass. Bypasses the staging ENVIRONMENT and the queue; bypasses neither guard 2 nor guard 5.

name: rollback_owed
description: production is serving this build and should not be, and the previous colour is still intact. Nobody has cut back yet. The estate is wrong and recoverable.

name: backed_out
description: change:backed-out. Production DID serve this change and was returned to a named prior state. TERMINAL, and the word asserts an estate action.

name: failed
description: change:failed. The change did not complete: production never served it, or never had it made live. Nothing to undo. TERMINAL.

name: abandoned
description: the PR was closed without ever holding the path to production. No closure code is owed because no change record was ever driven. TERMINAL.

name: backfill_owed
description: change:backfill-owed. An emergency reached main without the normal evidence and the record is unpaid: the window never booked, the observations never taken, and why. Blocks nothing.

name: estate_open
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. Ordinary change is permitted. The default disposition of the world.

name: estate_frozen
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. `freeze` on issue #1: ordinary change is suspended for everyone including its declarer. A property of the world, never of a change.

name: estate_emergency
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. `emergency` on issue #1: something is wrong out there and everything stops. Grants NO exemption to whatever PR carries it.

name: berth_free
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. No open PR holds deploy:staging. The path to production is available to exactly one claimant.

name: berth_occupied
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. Exactly one open PR holds deploy:staging and somebody is driving it.

name: berth_orphaned
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. deploy:staging is held by a change whose window is gone and whom nobody is driving. Guard 1 refuses everyone and names no cause.

name: lock_free
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. The deployment lock in the estate issue body is empty.

name: lock_held
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. The lock names a PR, a target, a run id and a start time. A record with a tiebreak, not the mutex.
